Description: Processed CAC datasets shall conform to a documented directory structure.
Required image subdirectories shall exist and be non-empty.
The system shall ingest cardiac CT image volumes from a specified root directory.
Rationale: Ensures controlled dataset ingestion for reproducibility.
Notes: Root path validated; ingestion logic centralized

Description: The system shall support volumetric CT formats commonly used in public CAC datasets.
Rationale: Ensures compatibility with public CAC datasets.

Description: The system shall fail gracefully with informative errors when required data is missing or invalid.
Data ingestion shall be decoupled from downstream model and training logic.
Rationale: Supports modularity and reuse of datasets.

Description: Dataset ordering shall be deterministic when configured.
PatientSample image_volume shall be a NumPy array.
PatientSample image_volume shall be three-dimensional (z,y,x).
Rationale: Ensures compatibility with 3D medical imaging models.

Description: PatientSample image_volume spatial dimensions shall be greater than zero.
PatientSample spacing shall be defined as (z,y,x) with all values greater than zero.
PatientSample shall define a non-empty patient_id.
Annotations may be optional but shall be valid if present.
Rationale: Supports supervised and weakly supervised use cases.

Description: Annotation slice indices shall be within volume bounds.
Vector ROI contours shall be valid (N,2) and within image bounds.
All PatientSample invariants shall be enforced at a single validation boundary.
Datasets shall expose samples via a consistent PatientSample interface.
Training runs shall persist model artifacts traceable to a specific run.
Training runs shall persist model checkpoints per epoch.
Dataset validation logic shall be isolated from dataset iteration logic.
Training runs shall record non-clinical evidence of execution.
Training and validation splits shall be deterministic and reproducible.
Each training run shall generate a unique and immutable run identifier.
Each training run shall persist dataset identity, split logic, and configuration.
Training and validation datasets shall be disjoint.
Training process shall record per-epoch training and validation metrics.
Training process shall detect and fail on numerical instability.
Each requirement shall trace to at least one implementation artifact.
Each requirement shall be verifiable via tests or artifacts.
